title: Sharing one fleet beats partitioning it
caption: The chapter's multi-tenant notebook: a fixed 30 GPU-equivalents of active workload needs 100 dedicated GPUs at 0.30 occupancy or about 43 shared GPUs at 0.70 occupancy. That is a 57 percent capacity saving and 2.33 times the active GPU-equivalents for the same 1.75 million dollar annual budget. Statistical multiplexing needs headroom for coincident peaks and isolation.

title: Platform returns are linear in model count
caption: Net annual benefit above a 2 million dollar platform cost, assuming 100 thousand dollars of recovered value per model per year. Break-even sits at 20 models; at 100 models the benefit-cost ratio is 5, a 400 percent net return. Recovered engineering time is capacity value, not automatic cash.
